referenceFunction.includedProcesses: This process models 1 meter of installed sewer infrastructure GFRP (glass fibre reinforced plastic) pipe and a trench depth of 3 meters. This process includes the production phase (A1–A3) and the construction phase/ transport (A4–A5) for 1 meter of installed GFRP pipe, including trench excavation and backfilling. Disposal and deconstruction processes are excluded and modelled separately specific for each sewer system type. The operation of similar types of building machines across different processes is aggregated to one process.
